title: Shadows over Shahu’s Land: The cost of loving and living across caste
description: More than a century after Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj, the ruler of Kolhapur, legalized inter-caste unions, the murder of a priest, symbolic funerals, and forced disinheritance reveal how caste prejudice is tightening its grip on western Maharashtra, even as safe houses and reformists keep hope alive, writes Radheshyam Jadhav
